name: Arlcoate Marius
original_name: アールコート・マリウス
source:
Arlcoate Marius is a student just recently graduated from the Military Academy of Leazas and joined the ranks as a soldier in the Black Corps. She's friends with [url=/c85436]Tilde Sharp[/url] from the Royal Guard, who recommended her to the Black Corps for her tactical talent.

Arlcoate is an extremely timid and shy girl that lacks self-confidence. She's incredibly submissive and is almost incapable of raising her voice. Despite this, her skills as a tactician are superb and some have claimed that she's an outstanding genius that could be one of the greatest tacticians in history, if she managed to overcome her lack of self-confidence. Regardless how much she's praised by others, Arlcoate still keeps a low opinion of herself.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Arlcoate_Marius]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
